title: Settings
intro: Your site's identity: your name, what you do, the address people can write to you at, and your social links. Here, a change goes live as soon as you save; in the editor, the same fields are published with the page you publish.
journalAsk: Need to know what was changed, when, and from which page?
draftPending: Site changes are waiting in the editor.
draftBody: The menu, header, footer or styles have been changed there but are not live yet: they will go live when you publish any page. The fields below already show what is pending for the name, role, email, credit line and social links: saving them here puts them live right away. The other pending changes (menu, styles, logo) stay as they are.
saved: Saved · visible across the whole site
siteNameHelp: At the top of every page and in the browser tab. If left empty in English, the French name is used.
contactHelp: The “Write” buttons open an email to this address.
roleHelp: Under your name (e.g. Illustrator & character designer).
socialsHelp: Shown in the footer and on the About page, in this order.
headerSocialsHelp: Right before the language switch (FR / EN), icons only; on a phone, inside the menu.
